title: Databases
description: Every database on every Spark, found automatically: PostgreSQL, Redis, MySQL, MongoDB, ClickHouse, vector stores and others.

panels.title: Long txns
panels.description: Open more than 5 minutes. Only measured where a login is allowed.

panels.title: Leftovers
panels.description: Stopped database containers with no restart policy, such as old test databases. They are not outages, and they still hold disk.

panels.title: All databases
panels.description: Found automatically on every Spark. Status, version, connections, CPU, memory and disk need no login. Detail says what else is known: `login` means full statistics, `info` means the engine answers without one, `liveness` means no credentials are in use for this project. Blank means not measured, not zero.

targets.expr: max by (node, container, engine, project, version, stats) (spark_db_info{node=~"$node",engine=~"$engine",project=~"$project"})

100 * sum by (node, container) (rate(spark_db_cache_reads_total{node=~"$node",engine=~"$engine",project=~"$project",source="hit"}[5m])) / sum by (node, container) (rate(spark_db_cache_reads_total{node=~"$node",engine=~"$engine",project=~"$project"}[5m]) > 0)
sum by (node, container) (rate(spark_container_cpu_seconds_total[2m]) and on (node, container) spark_db_up{node=~"$node",engine=~"$engine",project=~"$project"})
max by (node, container) (spark_container_memory_working_set_bytes and on (node, container) spark_db_up{node=~"$node",engine=~"$engine",project=~"$project"})
max by (node, container) (spark_container_memory_swap_bytes and on (node, container) spark_db_up{node=~"$node",engine=~"$engine",project=~"$project"})
sum by (node, container) (rate(spark_container_disk_written_bytes_total[2m]) and on (node, container) spark_db_up{node=~"$node",engine=~"$engine",project=~"$project"})

panels.title: Up over time
panels.description: From a handshake in the engine's own protocol: PostgreSQL answers an SSL request, Redis a PING, MySQL its greeting. A gap means the Spark was not reporting.

panels.title: Connections
panels.description: PostgreSQL: read from each backend's process title, so no login is needed.

targets.expr: sum by (node, container) (rate(spark_container_cpu_seconds_total[2m]) and on (node, container) spark_db_up{node=~"$node",engine=~"$engine",project=~"$project"})
max by (node, container) (spark_container_memory_working_set_bytes and on (node, container) spark_db_up{node=~"$node",engine=~"$engine",project=~"$project"})

panels.title: Data on disk
panels.description: Disk blocks in the database's named volumes, measured every 5 minutes.

targets.expr: sum by (node, container) (rate(spark_container_disk_read_bytes_total[2m]) and on (node, container) spark_db_up{node=~"$node",engine=~"$engine",project=~"$project"})
sum by (node, container) (rate(spark_container_disk_written_bytes_total[2m]) and on (node, container) spark_db_up{node=~"$node",engine=~"$engine",project=~"$project"})

panels.title: Detailed statistics: where a login is allowed, or the engine needs none

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (node, container) (rate(spark_db_cache_reads_total{node=~"$node",engine=~"$engine",project=~"$project",source="hit"}[5m])) / sum by (node, container) (rate(spark_db_cache_reads_total{node=~"$node",engine=~"$engine",project=~"$project"}[5m]) > 0)

panels.title: Longest transaction
panels.description: A long one stops vacuum and holds locks.

panels.title: Spilled to temp files
panels.description: Queries that ran out of work memory.

panels.title: File-based stores: DuckDB, LanceDB, Parquet and everything else under the data volume
Stores
panels.description: These speak no wire protocol, so they are measured from disk: size, file count and age. The warehouse snapshot's age is the one to watch. Anything else that appears at the top of the data volume is listed by itself.
